name: TradeNote
description: Open source trading journal that helps traders store, discover and recollect all their trades so they can become and remain consistent and profitable traders. Import broker executions, visualize performance, keep a diary, and annotate setups.
author: Eleven Trading

form_fields.label: Application ID
form_fields.hint: Random string used by the frontend to connect to the Parse backend. Auto-generated on install. Do not change after first start.

form_fields.label: Master Key
form_fields.hint: Secret master key for root connections to the Parse backend. Auto-generated on install. Keep this private and do not change after first start.

form_fields.label: MongoDB Username
form_fields.hint: Root username for the bundled MongoDB instance. Must match the user in the connection string.

form_fields.label: MongoDB Password
form_fields.hint: Root password for the bundled MongoDB instance. Auto-generated on install. Do not change after first start or the database will be inaccessible.

form_fields.label: Database Name
form_fields.hint: MongoDB database name used by TradeNote to store trades, diaries, and user data.
